g.text: 01 / WEALTH MANAGEMENT PATTERNS
Wealth AI augments preparation,
knowledge and professional review
Range / expert-authored planning
OCTOBER 2026 CONFERENCE ACCOUNT
Planners encode their method; agents draft in parallel.
Planners review and adjust. Measure accepted work
after correction before claiming added capacity.
Morgan Stanley / meeting to follow-up
JUNE 26, 2024 DISCLOSURE
Consent-based Debrief notes, action items, advisor-
edited follow-up and CRM capture. Separate Assistant
adoption from measured Debrief productivity.
UBS / institutional knowledge
FEBRUARY 4, 2025 DISCLOSURE
Red supports advisor access to product information,
research and CIO knowledge. Access is a workflow
mechanism; rollout alone does not prove outcomes.
RBC / client-context preparation
MARCH 27, 2025 INVESTOR MATERIALS
Use relevant client information for meeting preparation.
US-pilot conversion and survey adoption/satisfaction
have different evidence scopes and measures.
These are dated workflow examples. Drafting, reported deployment and adoption differ from better advice,
universal current availability, measured net capacity or causal client and revenue outcomes.
Sources: Range notes/session; Morgan Stanley press release; UBS results; RBC Investor Day presentation/transcript.
